changelog: **Board:** the vertical label of a collapsed empty stage is `text-gray-600` instead of `text-gray-500`. On the stage tints added in #3675, gray-500 measured 3.9–4.5:1 (under WCAG AA for 10px text) and turned the a11y baseline gate red on `/mentor/board`; gray-600 holds ≥ 6.1:1 on every tint. Dark mode maps both grays to the same colour, so it is unchanged.

en: Board: the names of collapsed empty stages are easier to read again.
tr: Pano: daraltılmış boş aşamaların adları yeniden daha kolay okunuyor.
de: Board: Die Namen eingeklappter leerer Phasen sind wieder besser lesbar.
